title: Austin Budget: Public Input & Strategic Goals
summary:
*   Austin residents were invited to provide feedback on the city's budget allocation.
*   Discussions focused on aligning the budget with new community outcomes and a long-term plan called "Strategic Direction 2023."
*   The event included an open house and a facilitated public discussion led by Mayor Steve Adler and City Manager Spencer Cronk.
*   This was an informational engagement session designed to gather public input, with no official decisions or actions taken.
